quests.title: May the Moonlight Connect Us

dialogue.t: Hmm? What are you looking at, {NICKNAME}?
Huh, what's he doing here all alone? Is he looking for The Damselette?
It kinda seems like something scared him. C'mon, let's bring him inside with us.
Columbina?
Zzz... Zzz...
Oh, she seems to be taking an afternoon nap. Guess we'll come back later.
No, wait! Don't go over there—
...Mmph!
Ouch...
Ah, you slipped? Don't worry, I'm not hurt. Hm? Oh, you two are here as well.
Guess a Moon Goddess isn't immune to a few bumps and bruises...
I don't mind little critters bumping into me, so long as the kuuvahki emanating from them reflects no ill-intent.
Did something happen? Why are you so afraid, little one?
Hm, I see.
Ooh, so you can understand these animals too?
The moon shines high over Nod-Krai. All animals that grow beneath the light of kuuvahki can be considered "familiars of the Moon Goddess."
So, what did this little guy say?
That monsters have appeared where he lives. He was looking for Lauma, but the monsters chased him to this area...
Ohh... No wonder he's so scared...
Back to Lauma, I think. She will know how to handle this.
Alright, looks like it's another trip out for us. Since we're heading to the Frostmoon Scions, make sure you hide extra good this time!
...Good idea. I'll ask Kunegunda to bring more fruit over later. She will need rest over the next two days.
Huh, looks like Lauma's busy right now. Let's give her a moment.
I realized, many years ago, that the Moonchanter is a figure of great importance to the Frostmoon Scions.
Sometimes, I think their task is even harder than that of a god.
Finally! She's got some free time. Let's—
My lady, some of the defensive structures over here require your attention.
Of course. I'll see to that right away.
And off she goes again! She never gets a moment's rest, does she?
C'mon, let's follow them. But, keep it quiet!
...This will do. Thank you.
Come night or day, may the moonlight connect us.
...Hmm? That saying has changed from when I last heard it.
Hey! That person left. C'mon, now's our chance!
Lady Lauma!
Seriously!?
...Thank you for your hard work. Excuse me for a moment. I will be back shortly.
There is no one around. You can come out now.
Wait, you knew we were here!?
How could I possibly miss the "Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar" and her kuuvahki?
Although... I'm not quite sure why you're following me. It's quite unnerving... being "observed" at work like this...
Oh, um... S—Sorry about that. We wanted to ask you about something, but the time was never right... Hopefully, we didn't stress you out too much...
Ah, I see... Understood. I'll handle it.
To be honest, after seeing how busy you are, Paimon kinda feels bad asking you to do more work...
Ah, it's nothing. Such is the duty of the Moonchanter.
...Now that you have seen all this, "Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar", what do you think of the Frostmoon Scions today?
The atmosphere is much changed from how it was several centuries ago. It's a good kind of change.
I'm glad to hear it... And I thank you for your kind words.
Give me your hand.
You too, {NICKNAME}.
...Oh, um... Why?
I like the current prayer you use around here.
...Come night or day, may the moonlight connect us.

quests.description: A small animal seems to be in trouble at the Silvermoon Hall…
